name: Minolta Finance Limited
about: Minolta Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the investment and financing activities in India. It offers loans and advances, capital market investments, inter-corporate deposits, and other allied financial services. It also provides trade finance, home, business, trade finance, loan against share, loan against gold, unsecured personal loan, purchase order financing, loan against property, microfinance, education, and two wheeler loan services. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Kolkata, India.
